provenance.approvedScope: headless report-only four-arm screen; no production/canonical/reference write
provenance.source: accepted Plan 13 race-physics.mjs; in-memory affine adapter and arm-specific transforms only
provenance.model: topSpeed = 8.25 + 0.5 * sampledPerformance; accepted base/rest/trial/stance order is unchanged
provenance.cells: 3 roster tiers × 2 field/race inputs × 2 stances × 2 trial states × 3 rest factors = 72

studyOnlyConstants.assistance: every40 ticks; 0.5 keyed success; rank 4-6; gap>=3m; topSpeed headroom>=0.25; curve distance minus existing braking distance>=15m; acceleration 5 vs 3 for max20 ticks; cooldown80; max2 executions/entrant
studyOnlyConstants.leader: at existing weave opportunity cadence, rank1-2 only, keyed target16-20deg, max15 hold ticks, max2 upgrades/entrant; accepted turn/recovery/contact values unchanged

provenance.order: Per tick, freeze ranks/gaps/speed/headroom/braking buffer; process existing weave keys/opportunity; process assistance from the frozen snapshot; then advance movement. Assistance has separate keyed draws and does not affect same-tick eligibility.

rear-assist.attribution: Paired arm deltas support causal comparison; individual within-race observed gap changes are descriptive, not attributed to a mechanic.
